find_places_in_text.description: Pick out the addresses, streets, cities and landmarks a piece of text mentions - an email, a post, a note - and get each with its coordinates, how sure Geocode.xyz is, and where in the text it was found. Optionally reads the text's sentiment too.

geocode_address.description: Turn an address, place name, postcode or landmark into a latitude and longitude, with the address split into its parts and how sure Geocode.xyz is of the match. Nothing found is reported with 'found' false rather than failing the step, so a workflow looping over a list carries on.

locate_ip_address.description: Find roughly where an IP address is - city, region, country, time zone and coordinates - with the street address nearest that point. Treat the street as the neighbourhood, not the building. A private address such as 192.168.1.1 comes back with 'found' false, since it has no public location.

description: Turn addresses, places and postcodes into coordinates and coordinates back into street addresses, worldwide. Locate IP addresses, pick out the places a piece of text mentions, complete partial street names, and look up Geocode.xyz's own short codes for a spot. Works without an API key on the free tier, which is shared and throttled; add a key for requests of your own.
